correctness.rationale: The original four-point metric has unit adjacent distances and two common diagonals t in [1,2]. Direct molecule mapping by determinant-4 matrix sends the unit ball to K_lambda=conv(cube [-1,1]^3 and four axial points ±lambda e1,±lambda e2), lambda=2/t. Four disjoint exterior face pyramids have total added volume 16(lambda-1)/3; polar is an l1 octahedron clipped on two axes with four disjoint caps, volume [4-(2-t)^3]/3. Reciprocal coordinate Jacobians cancel in Mahler product, giving 8(t+4)[4-(2-t)^3]/(9t). Independent exact SymPy differentiation gives derivative 8(3t^4-4t^3-12t²+16)/(9t²); the quartic decreases strictly on (1,2), is +3 at 1 and -16 at 2, implying unique maximum t≈1.121915780903. At t=1 P=40/3, t=2 P=32/3. Interior vertices/facets 12/18 and polar 18/12 are consistent with raised-face enumeration. Six rational polyhedral tests are corroborative, not continuum proof.
